# Mayors of Mead

 

M.S. Adams was the first Mayor elected to the Town of Mead in 1908. Since that time, Mead residents have actively contributed to the Town of Mead as elected members of the Board of Trustees. The Mayor presides over the Board of Trustees meetings, as required by statute, and for all ceremonial purposes, is the executive head of the Town. Below is a list of those who have served as Mayor. \*An asterisk represents missing or unconfirmed information. 

**Mayor** **Dates Served (Years)** Colleen Whitlow 2018-Present Gary Shields 2014-2018 Richard Macomber 2006-2014 Richard Kraemer 2002-2006 Keith Goshia 1998-2002 Patrick Peppler 1997-1998 Lisa Brown 1995-1996 Michael Schumann 1991-1995 Angie Pflipsen 1989-1990 Harvey Potts 1983-1989 Jay Hughes 1982 Robert A. Clark 1974-1982 Rodney Markham 1998-1974 Vernon Howlett 1966-1968 Miles Sandford 1964-1966 Rodney Markham 1959-1964 Elmer Newton 1951-1954 Ed Dempewolf 1950-1950 Bernard Newman 1948-1950 R.E. White 1945-1948 Pro Tem Trimble 1944-1945 R.E. White 1941-1944 A.F. Peters 1934-1941 * 1923-* T.H. Hill 1922-* J.B. Clymer 1918-* J.E. Kitts 1914-* J.F. Redman 1910-* M.S. Adams 1908-1910
